name: Hellsmelted raises Burning Blade's crit chance and damage by 30% (#2478)
contract: Hellsmelted 705016 reads 'Increases the critical strike chance and damage of Burning Blade by 30%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). The decoded client Spell.dbc capture (spell.csv.gz) shows this is already a fully-formed native record, not a gap: effect 0 is aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 29 (+1 from DieSides 1 = 30); effect 1 is aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE), BasePoints 29 (= 30). Both carry SpellClassMask (0,0,262144) - dword2 bit 18. Spell 524919 ('Burning Blade', the crit-triggered SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE + Armor-penetration proc cast from 524920's native PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL on melee crit, see aura_ascension_xoroth_event::Proc case 524920 in AscensionXorothEvents.cpp) carries that exact same family flags (0,0,262144), so the native spellmod pipeline already applies both bonuses automatically whenever the player casts 524919 - no entry exists for 705016 in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp because none is needed. This scenario is therefore a regression proof, not a functional change: nothing in ApplyContracts, AscensionXorothData.h's XorothEvents/XorothCoefficients lists, or AscensionStockCoefficients.cpp (which only clears BonusMultiplier, unused by SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) interferes with 705016's native record. spell_modifier reads the player's live spellmods without submitting a cast.
